column1: # Prototypes set by hand, where the analysis of the machine code cannot find them: address, convention
# (cdecl/stdcall/thiscall/fastcall), bytes the ret pops, the prototype in C (the decompiler's syntax: its name is
# the function's name), why.  tools/regparams.py and tools/stackparams.py take the registers, the pop and the
# parameter count from here, ghidra/ManualProtos.java the prototype.
# The MSVC runtime's helpers that set up their frame with __SEH_prolog4 (0x5E4910): EBP is the helper's, no input,
# and the parameters are read through it ('push 0x10; push scopetable; call __SEH_prolog4' at the entry).  Their
# callers lost the depth of the stack (0x50C3C0 constructs an array of objects with 0x5E4197).
